title: Regular-sequence kernels are independent of an essentially finite type regular local presentation
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $A$ a commutative local $k$-algebra essentially of finite type over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-essentially-finite-type-algebra]. Let $P$ and $Q$ be commutative regular local $k$-algebras [def-weil-regular-scheme], both essentially of finite type over $k$, and let $u:P\twoheadrightarrow A$ and $v:Q\twoheadrightarrow A$ be surjective local $k$-algebra homomorphisms (a local homomorphism sends the maximal ideal into the maximal ideal). Then $\ker u$ is generated by a finite $P$-regular sequence contained in the maximal ideal of $P$ if and only if $\ker v$ is generated by a finite $Q$-regular sequence contained in the maximal ideal of $Q$ [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence]. Empty sequences are allowed. No completeness hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 00SF (lemma-lci-local), equivalence of conditions (1) and (2), with the local complete-intersection condition expanded by Tag 00SD (definition-lci-local-ring). Over the field k, essentially finite type and essentially finite presentation agree.
